policies.title: Affordable housing and rent controls
policies.statement: Build large-scale social housing and introduce rent controls to address the housing crisis in urban areas.

policies.title: Net zero by 2040
policies.statement: Achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2040 through rapid transition to renewable energy and ending new North Sea oil and gas drilling.

policies.title: Public ownership of utilities
policies.statement: Bring railways, water companies, and major energy companies into public ownership to reduce costs for consumers.

policies.title: £15 minimum wage
policies.statement: Introduce a £15 per hour minimum wage for all workers regardless of age by April 2027.

policies.title: NHS funding and access
policies.statement: Increase NHS funding to guarantee access to NHS dentists and same-day GP appointments for urgent needs.

policies.title: Nature restoration and clean air
policies.statement: Enshrine the right to clean air through a Clean Air Act and restore rivers using nature-based flood solutions.
